summary: Comprehensive frontend-only E2E testing of the three change requests (Fuel dash + single volume unit, Time add/subtract with history, MEL calendar picker) plus regression. 37 assertions executed across Fuel, Time, MEL, Calendar modal, and Torque regression; all behavioral assertions passed. One expected-value in the script (Cat D for 2026-10-05) was incorrect in the spec — the app correctly computes 'Tue 02 Feb 2027' (Feb 2 2027 is a Tuesday). No bugs found. No React Native / Expo deprecated-package issues.
critical_code_review_comments: fuel.tsx: 'hasInput' gate correctly suppresses weight meta and shows '—' when either input empty; fuel-uplift-alt element removed as required; only one of L / US gal shown via volumeUnit setting.

time.tsx: history is a prepended list, total is derived from history[0].sum (clean source of truth). Minutes/hours regex strips non-digits; parseInt(h)*60 + parseInt(m) auto-normalizes 0:90 -> +1:30 correctly. 'apply' is a no-op when both inputs empty.

mel.tsx + calendar-modal.tsx: Pressable mel-date-input opens Modal; backdrop Pressable + inner sheet Pressable with noop onPress properly contains clicks; selecting a day calls onSelect then onClose; today-button and cancel-button wired; prev/next month navigation works; day cell testIDs stable (calendar-day-YYYY-MM-DD).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview app date is October 2026. URL https://flight-ops-calc.preview.emergentagent.com, viewport 390x844. New testIDs validated: fuel-uplift-volume shows '—' when either requested or shutdown is empty; fuel-uplift-alt no longer rendered (only one volume unit per settings). Time tab replaced the prior per-entry list with a running-sum history: time-hours-input, time-minutes-input, time-add-button, time-subtract-button, time-reset-button, time-total, time-total-decimal, time-history, time-history-empty, time-history-row-{0..n} (row 0 is newest). History rows contain delta (signed e.g. '+1:30' / '−0:45', note minus sign is U+2212) and running sum '= H:MM'. Calendar: calendar-modal, calendar-backdrop, calendar-prev-month, calendar-next-month, calendar-month-label (format 'MMMM yyyy'), calendar-day-YYYY-MM-DD, calendar-cancel-button, calendar-today-button. mel-date-input is a Pressable (not TextInput). Verified calculations: 5000/1800kg -> 4,000 L; USG -> 1,057; 100 Nm -> 885.07 in.lbs / 73.76 ft.lbs; 2026-10-05 -> B 'Thu 08 Oct 2026', C 'Thu 15 Oct 2026', D 'Tue 02 Feb 2027'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. 36/37 explicit assertions passed; the remaining assertion was a wrong expected weekday in the test script (Feb 2 2027 is Tuesday, not Monday) — the app is correct.
